title: Lemma engine API
description: Schema for the JSON document shapes the engine produces at its consumer boundary: Show (Engine::show), Response (Engine::evaluate), specs (Engine::specs, array of Repository), errors (array of EngineError), and RepositoryInstallResult (SDK install). Explanation trees live under RuleResult.explanation (RuleNode / ExplanationNode).

DecimalString.description: Arbitrary-precision decimal literal (never a JSON number, to avoid float precision loss). Maps to Java BigDecimal, a plain string in TypeScript/Elixir.

RationalFactor.description: Exact rational as a reduced numerator/denominator pair of arbitrary-precision integer strings.

MeasureUnit.description: One declared unit of a Measure type. `factor`: 1 of this unit equals `factor` canonical units.

derived_measure_factors.description: (measure_ref, exponent) pairs from a compound unit declaration (e.g. meter/second). Empty for base units.

TypeDefiningSpec.description: Where a custom type's extension chain is rooted.

TypeExtends.description: What a type extends: a primitive built-in, or a custom type by name.

LemmaType.description: Resolved Lemma type: `TypeSpecification` fields flattened alongside `name` and `extends`. Sentinel-only specifications (`veto`, `undetermined`) never reach the API and are excluded.

TypeSpecification.description: Element type of a list: the `LemmaType` fields without `name` and `extends`. A spec element names the row spec of an instance list. Lists do not nest.

ListKey.description: How a list addresses its rows: "numbered" (by row number), or the ordered `-> key` field names.

RuleResultValueEndpoint.description: RuleResultValue fields without `range` — a range endpoint must never itself be a range.

SpecRuleResult.description: One rule of a spec instance, or one evaluated data slot of a spec instance. A spec-valued rule nests SpecResult in result.spec.

SpecResult.description: Spec instance returned by a rule. data holds one evaluated entry per data slot, keyed relative to the spec; unbound slots are omitted.

path.description: One segment per uses hop of instance.

RowReference.description: A row of an instance list. Its data and rules are Response.rows[index]. instance is the row path relative to the spec holding this value (lines.2).

RowResult.description: Data and rules of one distinct row reached by a response, filled once and referenced by RowReference.index. Keys are relative to the row spec; unbound slots are omitted.

RuleResultValue.description: API value shared by RuleResult (flattened), Show property x-lemma-value/x-lemma-suggestion, and explanation Rule/Data nodes (flattened). When present: always `result`, plus exactly one typed field for a non-range value; `range` is set instead for a range value. A list sets `list`, one value per row. A list row sets `row` in rule results and RowResult members; in explanation nodes and Show it carries `result` only.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

PathSegment.description: One uses hop on a Show data or rule path. uses is the alias; repository is omitted for the unnamed workspace; spec is the resolved target name.

EvaluateDataJson.description: An evaluation-data JSON value: a literal string, a boolean, a list (array), or an object (list row, or single-unit measure map). JSON numbers and null are not evaluation data.

ShowPropertyType.description: x-lemma-type of a Show property: the LemmaType without help and text options/length, which the property states as description, enum and minLength/maxLength. Single spec types are uses aliases, never properties.

ShowPropertyElementType.description: Element of a list ShowPropertyType: the TypeSpecification without help and text options/length.

ShowItems.description: items of a list property: the element literal schema of a value list, or a $ref to the row object schema of an instance list in the document's $defs.

ShowProperty.description: One evaluation-data input of a Show document, keyed by its input key (dotted keys included). Standard keywords state the JSON shape; default/examples are the evaluation-data JSON of x-lemma-value/x-lemma-suggestion.

oneOf.description: Alternatives: text, boolean, or a single-unit object for measure and ratio data.

pattern.description: Literal grammar of number, measure and ratio inputs (ECMA-262).

x-lemma-path.description: Import hops to this slot. Empty means this spec.

x-lemma-needed-by-rules.description: x-lemma-rules keys that transitively need this data after normalize. Empty = reuse catalog only (not an eval intake key for this spec).

ShowRowSchema.description: Row object schema of an instance list, one per row spec in the Show document's $defs. Every row-spec data entry is a property, dotted uses fields included.

ShowConversionTarget.description: Target of a Show `as` conversion (inspection only).

ShowExpression.description: Resolved expression on a Show rule branch. Internally tagged by `type`.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

oneOf.description: Field of a computed row value: `(menu -> find ordered).price`.
Field of the current row inside a list command argument.
The current row's value inside a value-list command argument.
One `field: value` pair of an inline row appended by `-> with`.
Postfix list command (`staff -> sum bonus`). direction is present exactly on sort. A value-list condition is a comparison or range_containment whose left operand is row_value.

ShowBranch.description: One arm of a rule's flat last-match table. Default arm omits condition.

ShowRule.description: Rule on Show: result type, import path ([] = this spec), authored default/unless branches, and depends_on_rules (Show.rules keys).

path.description: Import hops to this rule. Empty means this spec.

depends_on_rules.description: Show.rules keys this rule depends on (planning topo). Always present.

SourceType.description: Provenance of a loaded source. Externally tagged; the unit `Volatile` variant is the bare string "volatile".

Show.description: Result of Engine::show: a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for the spec's evaluation-data inputs. properties holds inputs rules need (non-empty x-lemma-needed-by-rules), required the unbound ones, $defs instance-list row schemas. x-lemma-types is local data declarations; x-lemma-rules is this spec's rule graph (local plus reachable imports).

x-lemma-repository.description: Interned repository name. Omitted for the unnamed workspace.

x-lemma-types.description: Local data declarations (empty path), declaration order.

RuleResult.description: Result of evaluating one rule. RuleResultValue fields are flattened directly onto this object (no `value` wrapper key) when the rule is not vetoed.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

rows.description: Rows reached by results, in first-reached order, indexed by RowReference.index. Omitted when no result reaches a row.

SpecDependency.description: One uses target written on a spec version.

SpecVersion.description: One temporal spec version from Engine::specs.

dependencies.description: uses targets in declaration order. Omitted when empty.

Repository.description: One repository group from Engine::specs. `repository` is absent for the default unnamed repository.

EngineErrorSource.description: Source location attached to an EngineError. Line/column are 1-based; length is the UTF-8 byte length of the offending span.

Recommendation.description: Structural quality recommendation from Engine::quality. Advisory only.

effective_from.description: Declared temporal start of the analyzed slice, or null for Origin.

Cause.description: One evaluated unless condition, stated as a fact. A falsified comparison is flipped to its complement, so the condition text describes what held.

condition.description: True-form condition expression text from the source rule.

value.description: "true" for facts stated positively (including flipped conditions), "false" when the condition could not be flipped into a positive statement, or the veto text when evaluating the condition vetoed.

RuleNode.description: Root rule explanation under RuleResult.explanation. Nested rule uses are rule_ref into the rules table. RuleResultValue fields are flattened.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

rules.description: Narrated rules reachable from this root, referenced by rule_ref nodes. Ids are dense from 0 in first-reach order.

ExplainedRule.description: One narrated rule body in a root explanation's rules table.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

RuleRefNode.description: Reference to an ExplainedRule in the enclosing root explanation's rules table. RuleResultValue fields are flattened.

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

RowNode.description: One instance-list row a list command read. Label in ASCII is n. when unkeyed, or [key values] when field-keyed.

appended.description: True when the row was appended by an expression -> with.

key.description: Key field Data nodes in -> key order; empty for numbered lists.

FilterNode.description: Summary of a where filter: matched of total rows satisfied the condition.

DataNode.description: Bound data narration. RuleResultValue fields are flattened (result plus typed measure/ratio/… maps).

fields.description: Show only: on a source row of an instance list value, the fields the row sets, keyed relative to the row spec. Such rows and their list carry no result; row order is array order.

reference.description: Show only: on a source-row field whose value is a reference; the input key of the referenced data in the spec declaring the list.

DataUnusedNode.description: Data path present in a cause condition structure but never looked up (short-circuit or static and-false).

RepositoryInstallResult.description: Result of Engine.install / Lemma.install: LemmaBase repository source text and normalized id. Not yet loaded.
